gen-gf-paprika-gf-winky-rough: Scattered, loud letters in Paprika, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Winky Rough, a sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height, stays readable at a modest size.
gen-gf-paprika-sora: Big, shouty lowercase from Paprika fills every line. Sora draws smooth, geometric curves with no swell at the corners, and the step down in lowercase height is the real hook.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Distinctive, Phudu leaves generous openings at the end of every curve. But Pilcrow Rounded does the quiet work, tucking its big counters and tall lowercase into tightly spaced lines.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-actor: The body text reads clean and modern, its s curves barely curled in. Actor sits next to Phudu, whose single-width strokes and open terminals make it the louder voice of the two.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Phudu hits hard, its strokes as steady as a drawn string. Alegreya Sans SC, with its open, welcoming gap in the c, keeps a long run of text contemporary and inviting.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-andika: Bold from the first glance, Phudu leaves generous openings at the end of every curve. And Andika carries on with tails and terminals weighted like its stems, so paragraphs move along on wide, easy s turns.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-anta: Ballpoint-plain lines make Phudu look bold and distinctive. Anta, a sans with gaping e mouths and a wire-bent sign look, is the real draw, constant in thickness while Phudu stays bold.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-barlow: Barlow brings approachable, contemporary text, its c shapes pulled well apart and its strokes constant like a neon tube. Beneath a bold Phudu heading, it reads smoothly, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biz-udpgothic: Phudu builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness. BIZ UDPGothic loosens everything up beside it with lavish letter spacing, so the two feel approachable and modern together.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-bpmf-huninn: Phudu is bold, with a ballpoint's pressure-free line. Bpmf Huninn keeps a single-weight outline feel and wide channels into every bowl, so the two feel modern and unhurried in each other's company.
